content_units: Kyoto Temple-Visit Weather Snapshot
Kyoto looks progressively better each day from   Oct 14 to Oct 16, 2025 (JST)   for outdoor sightseeing.
The clearest and driest day is   Thursday, Oct 16  , making it the best pick for temple visits.
